summary: Jefferies Financial Group filed a Rule 424(b)(5) pricing supplement for $1,000 face medium-term notes due September 27, 2030, linked to the lowest of the Dow, Russell 2000 and S&P 500. The 9.00% per annum contingent coupon pays quarterly only if the worst index closes at or above the 75% threshold; securities auto-call from March 2027 through June 2030 at or above starting levels. Principal is at risk below the 75% threshold, with full downside exposure and no index participation. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation; no board recommendation, advisor, premium or deal terms involved.
